race.description: Sportsbet Supporters Of Having A Crack
race.comment: DR. BILL (1) broke through for his maiden success last time out at this track over 300m (17.07). Looks the one to beat. WHITE LINE (5) jumped from a low draw and boxed on well to finish second last time, beaten a long neck (17.20) behind Aston Major at this track. Hard to beat again. CHEEKY PROMISE (8) returns here with a good chance to improve on last time. Something for the Multiples: SMASH 'EM (3) TAKE A VIOLET (4)
